$comment: Source of truth for the upstream AG2 version these skills were verified against. To see what changed upstream since, diff the pinned commit: `git -C <ag2-checkout> diff ag2_commit..main -- ag2`.
scope_note: These skills document the AG2 API (the `ag2` namespace) ONLY. They do not cover AG2 Classic (the `autogen` namespace).
verification_method: All 26 SKILL.md files (plus references/ and assets/) were updated against the v1.3.0 tag source and website/docs, and their example code was executed against ag2==1.3.0 with live OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini models under `python -W always::DeprecationWarning` (no ag2 deprecation warnings). APIs deprecated in 1.3.0 and removed in 1.4.0 (OpenAIConfig as Chat Completions, Agent(knowledge=), Agent(assembly=), TaskConfig/tasks=, Agent.task(), AnthropicConfig sampling params) are only mentioned as migration notes. Not executed live: audio devices, gRPC, Daytona/Tenki sandboxes, real Claude Code/Codex ACP sessions, Bedrock/Mistral/xAI/Z.AI calls (signature-checked against source). Skill usefulness was measured with a 15-task Claude Haiku eval before and after the update.
